frequency_source: Repository owner: every baseline is timestamp plus 500 bins; retain the original proton sweep's bin offsets and spacing, replacing its nominal 213 MHz center with 32.7 MHz.
derivation: f_j = (212.6 + 0.0015287*j) - (213 - 32.7) = 32.3 + 0.0015287*j MHz, j=0..499. The last sample is 33.0628213 MHz; 32.7 MHz is the nominal center, not the endpoint midpoint.
